indicators.section: Indicators relating to romance fraud victims
indicators.flag: Client met the individual they are transacting with on a social media platform, via email or on a dating website.
indicators.red_flag: Online-met-only counterparty (dating-site / social-media origination)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag behavioural patterns consistent with scam victimization or vulnerable-customer exploitation â out-of-pattern payments to new beneficiaries, escalating transfer sequences to investment or romance-typed payees â escalating when the customer falls in a vulnerable segment.
build_logic.window: rolling 30 days per emerging payee relationship
build_logic.source: payment ledger + customer vulnerability segment + payee risk reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â fraud/AML & customer-protection review gate

indicators.section: Indicators associated with transactions related to romance fraud
indicators.flag: Client appears to be pooling all financial resources from various sources (e.g., credit cards, loans, retirement savings, insurance policies) and depleting assets (e.g., home, vehicle, investments and retirement savings) to fund transfers to individuals/entities.
indicators.red_flag: Multi-source asset liquidation funnel-in to fund outbound transfers
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Indicators associated with transactions related to romance fraud
indicators.flag: Client sends funds to another individual, and the amount or frequency of funds sent increases over time.
indicators.red_flag: Escalating send amount / frequency to single payee
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.section: Indicators associated with transactions related to romance fraud
indicators.flag: Client is transacting with one or more individuals suspected of being either a victim or perpetrator of romance fraud.
indicators.red_flag: Counterparty linked to known romance-fraud victim / perpetrator
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.section: Indicators associated with transactions related to romance fraud
indicators.flag: Client is identified as a victim and is transacting with one or more individuals who are also identified as victims of romance fraud.
indicators.red_flag: Victim-to-victim transfer chain (mule relay between victims)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.section: Indicators associated with transactions related to romance fraud
indicators.flag: Client either cancels transaction for no apparent reason or transaction is refused due to questionable rationale for it.
indicators.red_flag: Unexplained transaction cancellation / refusal
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Indicators associated with transactions related to romance fraud
indicators.flag: Client makes payments to online dating services or social media websites.
indicators.red_flag: Dating-service / social-media merchant-category spend
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: Indicators associated with transactions related to romance fraud
indicators.flag: Client conducts large volume and/or excessive number of transactions involving foreign jurisdictions over a short period.
indicators.red_flag: High-velocity cross-border transaction burst
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Indicators associated with transactions related to romance fraud
indicators.flag: Client receives funds from numerous individuals in multiple jurisdictions. The funds are then depleted by cash withdrawals conducted in Canada or abroad, or by wires to the benefit of individuals/entities in Canada or abroad.
indicators.red_flag: Multi-originator cross-border funnel-in → cash / wire drawdown
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Client conducts financial activity or holds accounts at multiple financial entities without adequate rationale.
indicators.red_flag: Multi-institution account spread without rationale
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Non-account holders or apparently unrelated individuals make deposits or payments to client’s account.
indicators.red_flag: Inbound deposits from unrelated third parties (funnel-in)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud

indicators.red_flag: No-relationship wire counterparty (sender / recipient unknown to client)

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Client frequently deposits fraudulent cheques or bank drafts that are later returned by the financial institution.
indicators.red_flag: Repeated fraudulent cheque / bank-draft deposits later returned
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D6 (Check / negotiable-instrument image & metadata), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Client appears to be directed by a third party to deposit funds into accounts or to wire funds to individuals domestically or in foreign jurisdictions.
indicators.red_flag: Third-party-directed deposits / wires (mule under direction)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Client sends and/or receives an increasing amount of wires/EMTs.
indicators.red_flag: Escalating wire / EMT send-receive volume
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Client’s wire transfers involve amounts or jurisdictions that are inconsistent with their profile.
indicators.red_flag: Wire amount / corridor out-of-pattern vs profile
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D3.

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Client receives multiple incoming wires into a business account in a manner inconsistent with day-to-day business.
indicators.red_flag: Inbound wires inconsistent with business operations
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account whose transaction inflows are disproportionate to its declared revenue, headcount, payroll, or operating-expense footprint relative to industry peers, escalating when revenue appears decoupled from any observable operational activity.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared profile and peer cohort
build_logic.source: business deposit ledger joined to KYC business profile + industry peer benchmarks
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Client makes numerous third-party cash deposits followed by outgoing draft/wire transfers to or cash withdrawals in high-risk jurisdictions.
indicators.red_flag: Third-party cash-in → high-risk-corridor draft / wire / cash-out
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.section: Indicators of mass marketing fraud
indicators.flag: Client receives payments from payment processors that are inconsistent with the client’s profile.
indicators.red_flag: Payment-processor inflows out-of-pattern vs profile
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D1.
